name: SubtitleCat
description: Search and download subtitles from subtitlecat.com.
overview: Search and download subtitles from subtitlecat.com. No account or API key required.
changelog: 1.0.6.0 - Prefer subtitles written in the requested language over machine translations. Each result row is labelled with the language it was translated from; a row sourced from the requested language is the original, anything else was machine-translated into it. Fixes the case where the most-downloaded row was also the most machine-translated one and therefore won the ranking.
